WITH keyword_prefix AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT lexical.message_id,bm25(lexical) AS keyword_rank FROM lexical WHERE lexical MATCH ?
                    ORDER BY keyword_rank,CAST(lexical.message_id AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY LIMIT ?
                ), qualified AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT messages.id AS message_id,min(keyword_prefix.keyword_rank) AS best
                    FROM keyword_prefix
                    CROSS JOIN lexical_docs d ON d.message_id=keyword_prefix.message_id
                    CROSS JOIN messages INDEXED BY evernook_recall_source_v1 ON messages.id=d.message_id
                    WHERE d.normalization_version=? AND (? IS NULL OR messages.id<>?)
                AND d.content_version=json_extract(messages.receipt,'$.content_version') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visibility v WHERE v.message_id=messages.id AND v.status<>'active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captures generated WHERE generated.message_id=messages.id
    AND json_extract(generated.manifest,'$.tool_name')='evernook_memory_reflect'
    AND json_extract(generated.manifest,'$.kind')='tool_result') AND json_extract(messages.receipt,'$.original_saved')=1 AND json_extract(messages.event,'$.text')<>''  GROUP BY messages.id ORDER BY best,message_id LIMIT ?
                )
                SELECT qualified.message_id, examined FROM (SELECT count(*) AS examined FROM keyword_prefix)
                LEFT JOIN qualified ON 1 ORDER BY qualified.best,qualified.message_id

WITH ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT c.message_id,c.start,c.end,c.state_version,occurred,
                    min(COALESCE(vec_distance_cosine(c.vector,?),-2.0)) AS distance,count(*) AS chunk_count
                FROM semantic_chunks_v1 c
                JOIN messages INDEXED BY evernook_recall_source_v1 ON messages.id=c.message_id LEFT JOIN visibility v ON v.message_id=messages.id
                WHERE c.space_id=? AND (? IS NULL OR messages.id<>?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visibility v WHERE v.message_id=messages.id AND v.status<>'active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captures generated WHERE generated.message_id=messages.id
    AND json_extract(generated.manifest,'$.tool_name')='evernook_memory_reflect'
    AND json_extract(generated.manifest,'$.kind')='tool_result') AND json_extract(messages.receipt,'$.original_saved')=1 AND json_extract(messages.event,'$.text')<>'' AND c.state_version=COALESCE(v.version,1)
                  AND c.content_version=json_extract(messages.receipt,'$.content_version')  GROUP BY c.message_id
            ), scan_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT sum(chunk_count) AS scanned FROM ranked
            ), candidates AS (
                SELECT 0 AS is_recent, global_top.* FROM (
                    SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY distance,message_id LIMIT 100
                ) AS global_top
                
            UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS is_recent, recent_top.* FROM (
                SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE occurred>=? AND occurred<?
                ORDER BY distance,message_id LIMIT 100
            ) AS recent_top
            )
            SELECT is_recent,message_id,start,end,state_version,distance,scanned
            FROM candidates CROSS JOIN scan_stats
            ORDER BY is_recent,distance,message_id
